messages:
Maria C: Quick heads-up — we're launching a Micro-Labs Passport for a set of onboarding + renewal-risk accounts. 30m hands-on office hours, focused on migration blockers and quick wins. Goal: reduce churn signals and unblock production installs. Sign-up sheet: https://bit.ly/micro-labs-passport :sparkles:

Sam J: Love it. I can take NA mornings (8–11am PT). How many concurrent slots per day? :coffee:

Maria C: Thinking 3 slots/day initially (max 6 pax each). Keep it tight and practical.

Elaine K: I can host APAC evenings Tue/Thu. I'll need a one-pager pre-read to surface infra needs + credentials checklist.

Priya S: Can we add a "Passport" tag in the CS app so routing sends priority accounts to these slots? If yes, we should capture renewal signal and last contact in the RSVP flow.

Tim O: Agreed on the tag. Ops asks we reserve 1 slot/week for high-risk escalations (internal only) — so effectively 2 public + 1 reserved.

Sam J: For capacity tracking, propose a simple formula in the sheet to show remaining seats: `=MAX(0, C2 - COUNTIF(Range, "registered"))` — C2 is capacity.

Elaine K: Runbook snippet for hosts (put in the repo once finalized):
```
- 0–5m: quick intros + confirm tenant/access
- 5–20m: repro + live fix or playbook runthrough
- 20–30m: next steps, assign owner, add to follow-up tracker
```

Maria C: Nice. I'll drop a template agenda into the sheet. Also add a link to the pre-read and the post-session feedback form (short 3 Qs + 1 NPS).

Priya S: Feedback form fields: 1) Did this session unblock you? (Y/N) 2) Biggest remaining blocker (short) 3) Likelihood to renew (1–5) + optional notes. Keep it <90s.

Tim O: Can we reuse the same Zoom link for all public slots and rotate hosts? Less overhead. We should rotate co-host privileges: @Elaine K, @Sam J, @Maria C. Remember to set waiting room off for speed.

Sam J: I'll update the shared calendar with recurring 3x/week blocks and add the sheet link. Can someone confirm timezone-friendly titles? e.g., "Micro-Labs Passport — NA Morning (8–9am PT)"

Maria C: Confirmed. Also tagging: add `priority:passport` label to events so CS inbox rules pick them up.

deploy-bot: calendar.create -> event_id=evt_gh12k, recurring=Mon,Wed,Fri; hosts=[Sam J, Elaine K, Maria C] :white_check_mark:

Elaine K: One more ask — include a copy-paste checklist for customers (commands, config snippets, sample env vars). I'll PR to the docs repo.

Maria C: Perfect. Volunteers: Sam (NA mornings), Elaine (APAC evenings), Priya (follow-up owner + feedback triage). Tim will handle reserved escalation slots. I'll consolidate the sheet + agenda and ping this thread when live. :party-popper:

Sam J: +1. Please add me to the RSVP watchlist so I get pings for cancellations.

Priya S: I'll wire the feedback form to a small dashboard (looker + Slack alert when NPS <= 3).

Maria C: Target: first public slots live next Tuesday. I'll post the final calendar + pre-read by EOD Friday. Thanks all.
